Black Panther: Wakanda Forever | Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez explore Marvel Studios’ Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, digging into the brewing rivalry between Wakanda and Talokan as Namor declares war over the world’s hunt for vibranium. They cover Shuri’s rise as the new Black Panther and Riri Williams’ debut as Ironheart, weighing what an uneasy truce between these two nations may mean heading into Avengers: Doomsday.
